title.narrative: Coalition Margins - Beyond Resistance: Queer and Feminist Strategies for Care, Visibility, and Justice

description.narrative: Coalition Margins' project "Beyond Resistance: Queer and Feminist Strategies for Care, Visibility, and Justice" is the continuation of the project "Empowerment, Safety, and Resilience: Fostering unity and coalitions for gender equality and LGBTQI+ rights" (Ref: SE-ON-802401-6134-WB-MK1) under the 2024-2025 programme “The Kvinna till Kvinna Regional Programme - Democracy and Resilience in the Western Balkans: Supporting Feminist Change Agents” (Ref: SE-ON-802401-6134-WB).

Within the Kvinnna till Kvinna Foundation's regional programme "Democracy and Resilience in the Western Balkans: Supporting Feminist Change Agents 2.0" the partner organisation Coalition Margins is implementing the 8-month project "Beyond Resistance: Queer and Feminist Strategies for Care, Visibility, and Justice". The project is centered around two main outcomes; Fostering understanding and dialogue among diverse stakeholders on gender equality, and fortifying women and queer human rights defenders’ resilience and enduring efficacy in advocacy efforts.
